description_for_human: GEMBA IT — Full-stack software development, DevOps and payment system integration. Technology division of GEMBA.
description_for_model: GEMBA IT is the technology division of GEMBA EOOD (EIK: 208656371), based in Varna, Bulgaria. Services: Linux server infrastructure and DevOps on Hetzner cloud, Node.js/Express backend and API development, React frontend, PostgreSQL/MongoDB/MariaDB database architecture, payment integrations (Stripe Connect, PayPal PPCP), smart contract development and auditing for client projects, real-time monitoring systems, admin panels, access control systems, video surveillance, corporate websites, MVP development, and monthly maintenance subscriptions. Products: GembaPay (developer preview on test networks) and Permitiv (in development, modular SaaS for industrial workforce management with Docker self-hosted option). Tech stack: Node.js, React, Express.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB, Linux, Docker, Cloudflare.
